quandoUsar: An assistant that sits beside the content it comments on (document, dashboard, editor) and pushes the page instead of covering it.
Short, contextual conversations about the current screen, with ready-made suggestions that send the prompt in one tap.
Split layouts: the panel chooses between docking and overlaying based on the width of its own container, not the window.
quandoEvitar: Use `chat-app` when the conversation is the whole screen, with a conversation list and replies that can be stopped or redone.
Use `drawer` for a temporary side panel that is not a conversation.
Use `prompt-input` with `message-scroller` when you need attachments, a model menu or a stop button: the prompt box built in here only sends text.

teclado.acao: In the prompt box, sends the text; during IME composition it does not send.
Inserts a line break without sending.
With focus inside the panel, closes the panel.
On a suggestion, sends its text as the prompt.
Moves through close, suggestions, prompt box and send; with the panel closed, nothing inside it receives focus.

acessibilidade: The panel is an `<aside>` labeled by the title; on open, focus goes to the prompt box and, on close, returns to the element that had it before, if it still exists (the built-in `launcher` leaves the DOM when the panel opens, so it does not get focus back).
The message list is `aria-live="polite"` and each message carries a screen-reader-only prefix; when closed, the panel is `inert`, and when open in overlay mode, the page behind it is `inert`.
Labels such as “Close”, “Send message”, “Conversation” and “Suggestions” are fixed in English; `title`, `subtitle`, `placeholder` and `emptyText` are yours.
movimento: When docked, the panel opens with a width spring and pushes the page; when overlaid, it slides over the page with a fading scrim.
New messages rise with a slight scale-up, suggestions enter in sequence when the panel opens, and the list scrolls smoothly to the end on each message.
With “reduce motion” on, the panel, messages and suggestions change state instantly and scrolling to the end is no longer smooth.
responsivo: A `ResizeObserver` measures the container: below `overlayBelow` (640 px by default) the panel slides over the page, with width `min(100%, max(width, 320px))`.
The prompt box grows with the text up to 132 px and then scrolls internally; suggestions stay on a single line, with horizontal scrolling.
desempenho: There are two `ResizeObserver`s per instance (container and list) and the list is not virtualized: very long conversations weigh on the DOM.
notasIA: Wrap the page: `children` is the content beside the panel, and the root uses `height: 100%`, so the parent needs a defined height.

The conversation is yours: pass `messages` (`id`, `role`, `content`), append the message in `onSend` and turn on `pending` until the reply arrives; `content` accepts nodes, such as a `StreamingResponse`.
Use `open` with `onOpenChange` and `launcher={false}` when the page already has its own button; this item depends on `loading-states` for the `pending` indicator.
